findings.reason: 225 hard items use the same generic supported-conclusion answer, reducing the need to apply topic knowledge.
22 endings describe unfinished content despite active chapter challenges.
Repeated feedback often restates one key idea instead of identifying the chosen misconception.
Long paragraphs and repeated instructions need editing where they obstruct the historical explanation; no validated reading-age score is assigned.
